think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether any numeric value(s) are documented to trigger a qualitatively different mode (e.g., disable/enable/auto/infinite) rather than just scaling the same behavior. 3) If such sentinel values exist (commonly -1, 0, or very large constants) and they change semantics, classify as a special knob and record those values; otherwise classify as non-special.
